dashboard_label: reference configuration, not a verified Saudi system

dashboard.status: REFERENCE - not a verified Saudi system

alarm_load.operator_norm: EEMUA 191 / ISA-18.2: about 6 per hour average is manageable; 12 per hour is the busy ceiling
alarm_load.agent_target: no more than about 1 agent alert per hour of healthy operation

dashboard.provisional: PROVISIONAL: static-alarm limits are PAH 1.02 x MOP, PAHH 1.05 x MOP (Addendum 1), gas temperature 85/100 C (JUDGE) and hydrogen 25/50 %LFL (INL); no real Saudi alarm settings are public

sensor_view.aggregation: channels faster than the 1 s grid are averaged over 1/period native samples; slower channels hold the last reading

valve_states.note: default ON for CGH2; run the ablation with valve_states=False

historian.level: reference configuration (STD) for the filters; deadbands per channel, compdev and fault rates are placeholders (Q10)
historian.layer_note: applied separately to the 60 s and the 1 s layer

static_alarm_basis: live DCS value (before the historian side channel), dashboard tags only
static_alarm_status: PROVISIONAL: static-alarm limits are PAH 1.02 x MOP, PAHH 1.05 x MOP (Addendum 1), gas temperature 85/100 C (JUDGE) and hydrogen 25/50 %LFL (INL); no real Saudi alarm settings are public
